evidence: We study ALD Al 2O3 depositions on HOPG using three surface treatments. The samples received 18 cycles of TMA-ﬁrst TMA / O3 ALD in a Picosun SUNALE™ ALD reactor at 30 ° C or 200 ° C. A single ALD cycle corresponds to the following precursor exposure sequence: TMA / N2 → N2/H2084930 s /H20850→ O3/H208490.2 s /H20850 → N2 /H2084930 s /H20850.
